'''Ottethan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories's]] [[Ottethan system/Legends|Ottethan system]], in the [[Ottethan Empire]]. It was ruled by a [[Ottethan warlord|warlord]] who married [[Neema-Da-Boda]], but later fed her to the [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] that roamed the planet.
